## 0.1.0-beta.27

- Send a report now also shows, for each playback, how fast the converted video arrived at the MiSTer (average and the busiest second) and how hard the MiSTer's decoder worked. Together with the server lines from beta.26, one report can now tell whether a stutter comes from the server, from the stream it sends, or from the MiSTer.

Existing beta access codes continue to work.
